source_text: XIX. Τοιαῦτα τὰ κατὰ τὸν μακάριον Πολύκαρπον, ὃς σὺν τοῖς ἀπὸ Φιλαδελφίας δωδέκατος ἐν Σμύρνῃ μαρτυρήσας μόνος ὑπὸ πάντων μᾶλλον μνημονεύεται, ὥστε καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν ἐθνῶν ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ λαλεῖσθαι, οὐ μόνον διδάσκαλος γενόμενος ἐπίσημος, ἀλλὰ καὶ μάρτυς ἔξοχος, οὗ τὸ μαρτύριον πάντες ἐπιθυμοῦσιν μιμεῖσθαι, κατὰ τὸ εὐαγγέλιον Χριστοῦ γενόμενον. Διὰ τῆς ὑπομονῆς καταγωνισάμενος τὸν ἄδικον ἄρχοντα καὶ οὕτως τὸν τῆς ἀφθαρσίας στέφανον ἀπολαβών, σὺν τοῖς ἀποστόλοις καὶ πᾶσιν δικαίοις ἀγαλλιώμενος δοξάζει τὸν θεὸν καὶ πατέρα παντοκράτορα καὶ εὐλογεῖ τὸν κύριον ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦν Χριστόν, τὸν σωτῆρα τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν καὶ κυβερνήτην τῶν σωμάτων ἡμῶν καὶ ποιμένα τῆς κατὰ τὴν οἰκουμένην καθολικῆς ἐκκλησίας.
orientation: The writers of the letter from Smyrna close the account by summing up who Polycarp was and where he now is.
pass_a_gloss: Such are the things concerning the blessed Polycarp, who, having suffered martyrdom in Smyrna as twelfth with those from Philadelphia, is remembered alone by all more, so that he is even spoken about by the nations in every place, having become not only a notable teacher but also an outstanding martyr, whose martyrdom all desire to imitate, which happened according to the gospel of Christ. Having overcome the unjust ruler through endurance and having thus received the crown of incorruptibility, rejoicing with the apostles and all the righteous he glorifies God the almighty father and blesses our Lord Jesus Christ, the savior of our souls and pilot of our bodies and shepherd of the universal church throughout the inhabited world.

choices.english: as twelfth with those from Philadelphia
choices.why: Inclusive counting: Polycarp is the twelfth together with eleven others, not twelfth after them.
Keeps the human political sense in context of trial and endurance; does not import the devil though the devil acts elsewhere.
Literal genitive of quality with fixed glossary crown; preserves reward language.
Literal ship image for one who steers; avoids modern governor which confuses with proconsul.
Required fixed glossary sense for worldwide shared congregation.

pass_b_english: This is the story of the blessed Polycarp. He suffered martyrdom at Smyrna as twelfth with those from Philadelphia. He alone is remembered by all above all others, so even the Gentiles speak of him in every place. He proved himself not only a notable teacher but also an outstanding martyr. His martyrdom happened according to the gospel of Christ, and everyone longs to imitate it.

By endurance he overcame the unjust ruler, and in this way he received the crown of incorruptibility. Now he rejoices greatly with the apostles and all the righteous. He glorifies God, the almighty Father, and he blesses our Lord Jesus Christ, the savior of our souls and pilot of our bodies and shepherd of the universal church throughout the world.
